title: Homomorphic Aggregation of Continuous-Variable GKP States
summary: Aggregating logical information in continuous-variable quantum networks is essential for distributed quantum architecture. However, direct passive linear optics degrade non-Gaussian Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) grid states via symplectic lattice compression and entanglement-induced decoherence when auxiliary modes are discarded. We present an active, measurement-based continuous-variable network primitive for combining spatially distributed computational-basis payloads.
